# Brutal Diablo

> Brutal Diablo is a free remaster mod for Diablo 1 (Diablo, 1996), built on DevilutionX. Same game, improved graphics, darker, bloodier. It is in development and coming in early 2027.

- The gameplay does not change: everything the mod adds is visual. Every picture in the game is recreated to match the original, with more blood and gore.
- Press H at any time to switch back to the original 1996 graphics, and again to come back.
- It needs your own copy of Diablo (1996), the old CD or the one sold on GOG: its DIABDAT.MPQ file, the same way DevilutionX does.
- PC first: Windows, Mac and Linux. Multiplayer for up to four players, as in DevilutionX.
- Free, and it stays free. Donations on Ko-fi, but a donation buys nothing extra.
- Hellfire is not supported for now. The gore cannot be switched off.
- It is a fan mod, not made by or affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

## Pages

- [Home](https://brutaldiablo.com/): what it is, the videos, the FAQ, the release list
- [Bloodier](https://brutaldiablo.com/gore/): the deaths and the blood
- [Items](https://brutaldiablo.com/items/): every item beside its 1996 picture
- [Tristram in 3D](https://brutaldiablo.com/tristram-3d/): the town rebuilt in 3D from the game's painting, to turn around and to download free as clay models (CC BY-NC 4.0)
- [Devlog](https://brutaldiablo.com/devlog/): how the bigger features were made ([RSS](https://brutaldiablo.com/devlog/feed.xml))
